tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Get the full transcript (captions) of a YouTube video. Returns plain text by default, optionally with [mm:ss] timestamps, or as SRT/VTT subtitles. Costs 1 credit on success.

tools.name: get_video_metadata
tools.description: Get title, channel, duration, views, likes, upload date, thumbnail and available caption languages of a YouTube video. Costs 1 credit on success.

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: List the videos (id, title, duration, URL) of a YouTube playlist or channel, newest first for channels. Use it before get_transcript to work on a whole playlist or a channel's recent uploads. Costs 1 credit on success.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_transcript, list_videos · Public sink: get_video_metadata.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_transcript, list_videos · Public sink: get_video_metadata

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
